    SELECT 
        YEAR(Date) AS year,

    GROUP BY 
        YEAR(Date)

    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_badges
    FROM 
        student_badges
    WHERE 
        badge_name = 'Student'
)
SELECT 
    (CAST(badge_counts_2010.badge_count AS REAL) / CAST(total_badges.total_badges AS REAL)) * 100 - 
    (CAST(badge_counts_2011.badge_count AS REAL) / CAST(total_badges.total_badges AS REAL)) * 100 AS percentage_difference

WITH MostInfluentialUser AS (
    SELECT Id, Reputation
    FROM stats_posts
    GROUP BY Id, Reputation
    ORDER BY Reputation DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
PostsAbove50 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(Id) AS CountAbove50
    FROM stats_posts
    WHERE Score > 50 AND Reputation = (SELECT Reputation FROM MostInfluentialUser)
),
TotalPosts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(Id) AS TotalPosts
    FROM stats_posts
    WHERE Reputation = (SELECT Reputation FROM MostInfluentialUser)
)
SELECT CAST(PostsAbove50.CountAbove50 AS REAL) * 100 / TotalPosts.TotalPosts AS PercentageAbove50
